I will buy some urea and DAP from the farmers' cooperative because the soil is tired, and I will also spread manure from my cattle since I have them. I will use my own saved seed—improved seed for this crop is either not available or too expensive at the market. My family will do most of the work by hand, including weeding without chemicals, and I will hire a few extra hands only if the weeding or harvest is heavy.
